meta.title: Daymark — your own social app
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Lands in the /daymark app shell, logged in as admin.
meta.author: jeffpaul

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Everything the demo shows (the followed sites, the sample Marks) is set up
// by one script, shared with the pull request previews and the wordpress.org
// Live Preview. This preview installs the repository as the plugin, so the
// script is in the plugin's own folder.
if ( defined( 'DAYMARK_PLUGIN_FILE' ) ) {
	$demo = dirname( DAYMARK_PLUGIN_FILE ) . '/.github/blueprints/set-up-demo.php';
	if ( file_exists( $demo ) ) {
		require $demo;
	}
}
